filmhouse.title: A Poet
filmhouse.description: Oscar is an aging, rueful poet whose artistic ambitions have long faded into obscurity and heavy drinking. When Oscar takes up teaching to meet ends meet, he encounters Yurlady, a working-class girl with an extraordinary gift for poetry, he becomes consumed with launching her talent into the local literary scene. Driven by a desperate longing for career redemption and a second chance at fatherhood, Oscar inadvertently pushes her into an ambitious world she never asked to join. Directed by Simón Mesa Soto, this tragicomedy earned the Un Certain Regard Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival and represented Colombia as its official submission for Best International Feature Film. Anchored by a brilliant, cringe-inducing performance from Ubeimar Rios, the film offers a darkly funny and deeply humane satire on artist egos and the messy search for purpose. In Spanish with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Nudity.

filmhouse.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
filmhouse.description: Haru, a competitive ballroom dancer in Tokyo, finds her world shattered when a sudden tragedy takes her husband-cum-dance partner from her side. Withdrawn into deep isolation and grief, she slowly allows her friends to coax her back onto the floor, where an unexpected connection with a new instructor reignites her passion. As she navigates life after loss, Haru stumbles through awkward choices, finding that healing is an exuberant, messy, and wildly colorful process. Featuring a charismatic lead performance by Rinko Kikuchi(Pacific Rim), the film presents an energetic, unabashed and fantastical way of moving on. In Japanese, Spanish and English with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Sexual Scene and Mature Content.

filmhouse.title: Ratatouille
filmhouse.description: In the high-stakes culinary capital of Paris, Remy, a gifted rat with an extraordinarily refined palate, dreams of becoming a master chef despite the obvious hazards of his species. After accidentally arriving at the legendary Gusteau’s restaurant, he forms an unlikely partnership with Linguini, a clumsy kitchen garbage boy with zero culinary skills. Hiding beneath Linguini’s chef hat and pulling his hair like a puppeteer, Remy crafts exquisite dishes that captivate the city, all while dodging an scheming head chef and Paris’s most dreaded food critic, Anton Ego. Winner of the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, Brad Bird’s Pixar masterpiece is a brilliant, kinetic tribute to French gastronomy and the transformative power of art. Elevated by Michael Giacchino’s iconic, jazz-infused score and breathtaking visual detail, the film balances slapstick physical comedy with a deeply resonant message on talent, passion, and perseverance. A perennial audience favorite that appeals equally to families, cinephiles, and food lovers! In English. Rated PG.

filmhouse.title: Days of Heaven
filmhouse.description: Set against the sweeping wheat fields of the 1916 Texas Panhandle, Terrence Malick’s romantic masterpiece follows Bill (Richard Gere) and Abby (Brooke Adams), lovers posing as brother and sister while fleeing a turbulent past in Chicago. When a wealthy, ailing farmer (Sam Shepard) falls for Abby, a desperate scheme for survival spirals into a tragic love triangle. Narrated through the perspective of Bill’s younger sister Linda (Linda Manz), Days of Heaven is an intoxicating fable of desire, fate, and human frailty. Supervised by Malick, this 4K restoration restores the film’s world famous "magic hour" cinematography—shot almost exclusively during twilight by Néstor Almendros and Haskell Wexler—to pure painterly brilliance. Paired with Ennio Morricone’s bittersweet, haunting score, it remains an unmatched sensory triumph In English. Rated PG.

filmhouse.title: The Violinist
filmhouse.description: Set across the shifting landscape of colonial Singapore and wartime Malaya, two musically gifted childhood friends—Fei and Kai—are bound together by their shared devotion to the violin. When the brutal onset of World War II and the Japanese Occupation tears them apart, Fei embarks on a decades-long journey across a changing Southeast Asia, holding onto memory, resilience, and the power of music as she searches for her lost friend. A landmark achievement for local cinema, co-directors Ervin Han and Raúl García’s hand-drawn feature made history by winning the prestigious Cristal Award for Best Feature at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, alongside the SACEM Award for Best Original Soundtrack. Blending meticulous traditional craft with an evocative score by Ricky Ho, the film transforms regional history into a deeply human, universally resonant story that demands to be experienced on the big screen Director Q&A, Sunday 4 Oct Join us for an in-person Q&A with Co-Director Ervin Han , alongside Art Director and Storyboard Artist Ong Ruwei , Character Designer Sakura Wong and Animation Supervisor Wendy Li . In English with English and Mandarin subtitles. Rated PG for Some Violence

filmhouse.title: Fargo (30th Anniversary)
filmhouse.description: Jerry, a small-town Minnesota car salesman is bursting at the seams with debt... but he's got a plan. He's going to hire two thugs to kidnap his wife in a scheme to collect a hefty ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. It's going to be a snap and nobody's going to get hurt... until people start dying. Enter Police Chief Marge, a coffee-drinking, parka-wearing - and extremely pregnant - investigator who'll stop at nothing to get her man. And if you think her small-time investigative skills will give the crooks a run for their ransom... you betcha! In English Rated M18 for Violence.

filmhouse.title: Taste of Cherry
filmhouse.description: A man drives around Tehran searching for someone to bury him after he takes his own life. Along the way, he meets strangers who each try, in their own way, to talk him out of it. Taste of Cherry, Abbas Kiarostami’s most recognised work, won't let you down with the simple yet profound journey it takes you on. Presenting CINEMATIC VOIDS : a curated film series in collaboration with Singapore Art Museum , accompanying the ongoing exhibition ‘ Hiroshi Sugimoto: Form Is Emptiness ’ In Persian with English subtitles Rated PG13 for Some Mature Content.

filmhouse.title: The Last Viking
filmhouse.description: After serving fourteen years for robbery, Anker is released from prison and reunites with his mentally ill brother Manfred, who alone knows where the stolen money is hidden but has forgotten its location, sending them on a journey to recover the loot and confront who they are. In Danish with English subtitles Rated NC16 for Some Violence. Presented at Filmhouse as part of the Nordic Film Festival, in partnership with the Royal Danish Embassy.

filmhouse.title: Memories of Origin: Hiroshi Sugimoto
filmhouse.description: This documentary follows 200 days in the life of contemporary artist Hiroshi Sugimoto— a leading presence in the world of modern art. He is the winner of many prestigious awards and his photographs are sold for millions of yen at overseas auctions. The film shows the sites of the Architecture series shot in southern France, the huge installation art work at 17th Biennale of Sydney, his new work Mathematics at Provence, his art studio while working on Lightning Fields, and more. It thoroughly pursues the question Sugimoto's works pose - "living in modern times, what are these works trying to tell us?" A thrilling look into the world of Hiroshi Sugimoto. Presenting CINEMATIC VOIDS : a curated film series in collaboration with Singapore Art Museum , accompanying the ongoing exhibition ‘ Hiroshi Sugimoto: Form Is Emptiness’ In Japanese with English subtitles. Rated PG.

filmhouse.title: Cinema Paradiso
filmhouse.description: The ultimate love letter to moviegoing comes to Filmhouse in luminous 4K! Set in a sun-drenched Sicilian village, Giuseppe Tornatore’s timeless masterpiece follows young Salvatore as he discovers the magic of cinema inside his local picture house, guided by the wise and grumpy projectionist Alfredo (Philippe Noiret). Presented as the Oscar-winning International Theatrical Cut—gloriously restored in 4K—this quintessential ode to youth, lost love, and silver-screen magic features Ennio Morricone’s most heart-swelling, immortal score. In Italian with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Sexual References.

filmhouse.title: La La Land (10th Anniversary)
filmhouse.description: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart. In English with Mandarin Subtitles Rated PG13 for Some Coarse Language

filmhouse.title: No Country for Old Men
filmhouse.description: Llewelyn Moss stumbles upon dead bodies, $2 million and a hoard of heroin in a Texas desert, but methodical killer Anton Chigurh comes looking for it, with local sheriff Ed Tom Bell hot on his trail. The roles of prey and predator blur as the violent pursuit of money and justice collide. In English. Rated NC16 for Violence.

filmhouse.title: Before Sunset
filmhouse.description: Nine years after their chance encounter in Vienna, American author Jesse and French environmentalist Céline cross paths once more in a Paris bookstore on the final leg of Jesse’s European book tour. With barely an hour before Jesse must catch his flight back to the United States, the pair wander through sunlit Parisian alleyways, quiet cafes, and a barge along the Seine. As their casual catch-up unfolds in near real-time, playful conversation rapidly gives way to an intimate confrontation with lost time, unfulfilled promises, and the quiet regrets of adulthood. Nominated for the Academy Award for Best Adapted Screenplay, Richard Linklater’s second entry in his seminal Before trilogy is a masterpiece of naturalistic, dialogue-driven cinema. Co-written by Linklater, Ethan Hawke, and Julie Delpy, the film builds extraordinary emotional tension through razor-sharp honesty, precise pacing, and effortless chemistry between its leads. In English. Rated NC16.

filmhouse.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
filmhouse.description: Haru, a competitive ballroom dancer in Tokyo, finds her world shattered when a sudden tragedy takes her husband-cum-dance partner from her side. Withdrawn into deep isolation and grief, she slowly allows her friends to coax her back onto the floor, where an unexpected connection with a new instructor reignites her passion. As she navigates life after loss, Haru stumbles through awkward choices, finding that healing is an exuberant, messy, and wildly colorful process. Featuring a charismatic lead performance by Rinko Kikuchi(Pacific Rim), the film presents an energetic, unabashed and fantastical way of moving on. In Japanese, Spanish and English with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Sexual Scene and Mature Content.

filmhouse.title: Anatomy of a Fall
filmhouse.description: When a man falls to his death from a remote chalet in the French Alps, his wife—a successful German novelist—becomes the prime suspect in a murder trial. With no direct witnesses other than their visually impaired young son, the courtroom proceedings gradually shift from analyzing physical evidence to dissecting the private fractures of their marriage. Winner of the Palme d'Or at the Cannes Film Festival and the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay, Justine Triet’s psychological drama is a masterclass in narrative tension and moral ambiguity. Powered by a commanding performance from Sandra Hüller, it is a sharp, provocative examination of truth, perspective, and relationship dynamics. In French and English with English subtitles. Rated NC16 for Some Mature References. TW: Contains scene(s) of animal abuse.

filmhouse.title: A Poet
filmhouse.description: Oscar is an aging, rueful poet whose artistic ambitions have long faded into obscurity and heavy drinking. When Oscar takes up teaching to meet ends meet, he encounters Yurlady, a working-class girl with an extraordinary gift for poetry, he becomes consumed with launching her talent into the local literary scene. Driven by a desperate longing for career redemption and a second chance at fatherhood, Oscar inadvertently pushes her into an ambitious world she never asked to join. Directed by Simón Mesa Soto, this tragicomedy earned the Un Certain Regard Jury Prize at the Cannes Film Festival and represented Colombia as its official submission for Best International Feature Film. Anchored by a brilliant, cringe-inducing performance from Ubeimar Rios, the film offers a darkly funny and deeply humane satire on artist egos and the messy search for purpose. In Spanish with English subtitles. Rated M18 for Nudity.

filmhouse.title: We Are All Strangers
filmhouse.description: A life-altering event forces 21-year-old Junyang and his girlfriend to face reality. At the same time, while Junyang’s father is struggling to hold their modest life together, a woman enters his life and both generations are forced to redefine their family. Cast Q&A, Sun 6 Sep Join us for an in-person Q&A with Cast Members, Andi Lim, Koh Jia Ler and Regene Lim, moderated by Petrina Kow. In Mandarin and English with English and Mandarin subtitles. Rated PG13 for Some Coarse Language and Sexual References. TW: Contains scenes with flashing lights, photosensitive viewers are advised.

filmhouse.title: Perfect Days
filmhouse.description: Hirayama works as a cleaner of public toilets in Tokyo, leading a quiet, contentment-driven life structured around classic rock cassettes, secondhand books, and photographing the light filtering through urban trees. As small, unexpected encounters break his daily routine, quiet details of his past gradually come to light. Directed by Wim Wenders, this Oscar nominee for Best International Feature earned Kōji Yakusho the Best Actor prize at the Cannes Film Festival. Celebrating the dignity of labor and the art of mindfulness, the film offers a warm, contemplative, and visually striking observation of contemporary Tokyo. In Japanese with English subitles. Rated PG for Brief Nudity

filmhouse.title: Trainspotting (4K Restoration)
filmhouse.description: Danny Boyle's decade-defining adaptation of Irvine Welsh's Trainspotting celebrates its 30th anniversary in 2026, and is heading back to Filmhouse from 21 August in a 4K restoration as part of our Music In Film showcase! Ewan McGregor stars as Mark Renton, the most reflective member of a group that also includes the compulsive womaniser, Sick Boy (Jonny Lee Miller), and the hapless Spud (Ewen Bremner). Renton, Spud and Sick Boy's issues with drugs alternatively irritate and amuse their friend, Begbie (Robert Carlyle), a periodic psychopath whose outbursts of violence are one of the many factors that convince Renton to leave for London in the hope of starting a new life. Renton enjoys some success remoulding himself as an estate agent in the English capital, but it isn't long before his Edinburgh friends catch up with him. Begbie and co. need the money Renton has saved from his job to finance the drug deal that could make them all rich... In English with English subtitles. Rated R21 for Drug Use and Sexual Scenes

filmhouse.title: The Violinist
filmhouse.description: Set across the shifting landscape of colonial Singapore and wartime Malaya, two musically gifted childhood friends—Fei and Kai—are bound together by their shared devotion to the violin. When the brutal onset of World War II and the Japanese Occupation tears them apart, Fei embarks on a decades-long journey across a changing Southeast Asia, holding onto memory, resilience, and the power of music as she searches for her lost friend. A landmark achievement for local cinema, co-directors Ervin Han and Raúl García’s hand-drawn feature made history by winning the prestigious Cristal Award for Best Feature at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, alongside the SACEM Award for Best Original Soundtrack. Blending meticulous traditional craft with an evocative score by Ricky Ho, the film transforms regional history into a deeply human, universally resonant story that demands to be experienced on the big screen Director Q&A, Sunday 4 Oct Join us for an in-person Q&A with Co-Director Ervin Han , alongside Art Director and Storyboard Artist Ong Ruwei , Character Designer Sakura Wong and Animation Supervisor Wendy Li . In English with English and Mandarin subtitles. Rated PG for Some Violence

filmhouse.description: An unexpected meeting on a train leads two travelers to spend an evening wandering through Vienna. As the night unfolds, they share stories and conversations about life and love, exploring new ideas while a quiet intimacy grows between them, knowing it may be their only night together. In English. Rated NC16.

filmhouse.title: The Big Lebowski
filmhouse.description: Jeffrey 'The Dude' Lebowski, a Los Angeles slacker who only wants to bowl and drink White Russians, is mistaken for another Jeffrey Lebowski, a wheelchair-bound millionaire, and finds himself dragged into a strange series of events involving nihilists, adult film producers, ferrets, errant toes, and large sums of money. In English. Rated M18 for Coarse Language Come dressed as your favourite Lebowski character and get 10% off at the bar

filmhouse.title: The Day Iceland Stood Still
filmhouse.description: When 90% of the women of Iceland walked off the job and out of their homes one fall morning in 1975 refusing to work, cook, or take care of the children, they brought their country to a standstill and catapulted Iceland to the “best place in the world to be a woman.” Told for the first time by the women themselves, and laced with playful animation, the story is subversive and unexpectedly funny. “ We loved our male chauvinist pigs ,” recalls one of the activists, “We just wanted to change them a little!” Directed by Emmy award-winning US filmmaker Pamela Hogan in collaboration with acclaimed Icelandic producer Hrafnhildur Gunnarsdóttir, and perfectly timed for release in the lead-up to the strike’s 50th anniversary, The Day Iceland Stood Still inspires viewers to reimagine the possible In English Rated PG13 for Some Coarse Language. Presented at Filmhouse as part of the Nordic Film Festival, in partnership with the Embassy of Iceland.

filmhouse.title: Fatherland
filmhouse.description: FATHERLAND centres on the relationship between the Nobel Prize-winning writer Thomas Mann and his daughter Erika, actress, writer and rally driver. In the summer of 1949, at the height of the Cold War, father and daughter embark on a challenging and emotional road trip in a black Buick taking them across a Germany in ruins – from US dominated Frankfurt to Soviet controlled Weimar. Returning home after sixteen years of exile in the US, Thomas Mann has to face not only a divided fatherland, but also deep fracture within his own family. In German with English subitltes . Rating NC16. Some Mature Content Co-presented by Goethe-Institut Singapore, Embassy of Italy in Singapore & Embassy of the Republic of Poland in Singapore TW: Contains scenes with flashing lights, photosentive audience is advised.

filmhouse.title: Fargo (30th Anniversary)
filmhouse.description: Jerry, a small-town Minnesota car salesman is bursting at the seams with debt... but he's got a plan. He's going to hire two thugs to kidnap his wife in a scheme to collect a hefty ransom from his wealthy father-in-law. It's going to be a snap and nobody's going to get hurt... until people start dying. Enter Police Chief Marge, a coffee-drinking, parka-wearing - and extremely pregnant - investigator who'll stop at nothing to get her man. And if you think her small-time investigative skills will give the crooks a run for their ransom... you betcha! In English Rated M18 for Violence.

upcoming.title: It Ends
upcoming.description: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an infinite highway with otherworldly terrors lurking beyond. Confined in their Jeep Cherokee, they must decide whether to accept their fate or attempt escape.

upcoming.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
upcoming.description: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

upcoming.title: Verity
upcoming.description:
Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive,
psychological thriller follows renowned author Verity Crawford (Anne
Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who
relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity. After Lowen
uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she
wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband
Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), and finds it hard to separate fiction from reality,
manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.

upcoming.title: Digger
upcoming.description:
The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything. 

Tom Cruise stars alongside Oscar winner Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Oscar nominee Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Oscar nominee Jesse Plemons.

upcoming.title: By Any Means
upcoming.description: A notorious mafia hitman and a young Black FBI agent team up to investigate the murders of civil rights leaders in 1966 Mississippi.

upcoming.title: Other Mommy
upcoming.description: From producer James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror, and Blumhouse Atomic Monster, the studio behind Backrooms and Obsession, comes a terrifying trip from breakout genre director Rob Savage, into the darkening world of a young girl, Bela, who forms a relationship with a sinister entity in her home who looks uncannily like her own mother.

upcoming.title: PACE (Local)
upcoming.description: Fresh out of rehab, Malcolm, a 40-year old former addict, looks for purpose in his late brother’s passion for running. But confronted with unresolved family expectations, a judgmental society, and destructive self-loathing, can Malcolm keep pace, or will he succumb to the unrelenting tempo of society?

upcoming.title: The Sandbox
upcoming.description: When an online rumour starts that Marvel is looking to cast its next big superhero out of Singapore, Sandbox, a struggling stunt training school, is suddenly inundated with hopeless wannabes hoping to become movie stars. With only a week to make them look good, can the Sandbox team turn these zeroes into heroes… and maybe save themselves in the process?

upcoming.title: The Social Reckoning
upcoming.description: A companion piece to the hit film The Social Network, Sorkin’s original screenplay is based on the events that gave rise to the Wall Street Journal’s shocking exposé The Facebook Files. The film is inspired by the true story of how Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

upcoming.title: [CANTO] The Mage
upcoming.description: THE MAGE follows Lan Pui-ching (Josie Ho), an eccentric woman who carries a large cloth bag collecting “trash”. She repeatedly appears at crime scenes where police have ruled as suicides or accidents. Officer Wong Ming (Carlos Chan) initially believes that she is mentally unstable, until he discovers that she has the ability to communicate with the dead. As the two investigate the victims, they uncover a sinister conspiracy. With the true mastermind lurking in the shadows, Lan Pui-ching must overcome the inner demons that have haunted her for 13 years and stop the next murder in a world where science and supernatural collide.

upcoming.title: Crawlers
upcoming.description: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

upcoming.title: Street Fighter
upcoming.description: Street Fighters Ryu and Ken reunite when Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. As they face a hidden conspiracy, they must confront each other and their past-or face destruction.

upcoming.title: Whalefall
upcoming.description: Following the death of his father (Josh Brolin), Jay Gardiner (Austin Abrams) goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

upcoming.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
upcoming.description: Hip-hop journalist Ali G returns after 20 years to make a documentary with real people. Cameras follow him for over a year as he takes classes, walks the streets, and appears on shows, often with his pregnant girlfriend.

upcoming.title: Clayface
upcoming.description: DC Studios’ first-ever foray into the genre, “Clayface” is a horror thriller from director James Watkins, starring Tom Rhys Harries in the title role of the Gotham City villain. It unravels one man’s horrifying descent from rising Hollywood star to revenge-filled monster in a story that explores the loss of one’s identity and humanity, corrosive love, and the dark underbelly of scientific ambition.

upcoming.title: Henry's First Dates (THAI)
upcoming.description:
They say the first date is the most exciting moment in any relationship —
a feeling you only get once! Except for ‘Lucy’ (Minnie Nicha Yontararak), who’s
living her first date on repeat with ‘Henry’ (Nadech Kugimiya), a good-natured,
animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can’t
remember anything from the day before. So, Lucy has to find a way to keep
wooing Henry, to make him fall in love with her every singe day. And that’s before
she even gets past his family and the people closest to him: Dad (Kiat Kitjaroen),
Ka-noon (Ble Patoomrach), and Auntie Su (Tipagorn Chaiprasit). Can Lucy make
Henry fall for her, again and again? Or will he forget her… forever?

upcoming.title: Sense And Sensibility
upcoming.description: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen’s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esmé Creed-Miles.

upcoming.description: A highly decorated combat vet, Ryan ''Fang'' Flanagan, is fleeing a murder scene at 130 miles an hour in a Mustang Shelby Super Snake GT350.

upcoming.title: The Weight
upcoming.description: Desperate to save what is left of his family, during the height of the Great Depression a battle-scarred veteran is hired to help smuggle a fortune in gold across 100 miles of impenetrable wilderness.

upcoming.title: The Cat in the Hat
upcoming.description: In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, The Cat in the Hat comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, doing what he does best— spreading joy to “happyless” kids. In the film, The Cat takes on his toughest assignment yet… to cheer a pair of siblings struggling with their move to a new town.

upcoming.title: The Land Of Sometimes
upcoming.description: Twins Alfie and Elise find a magical Wish Watch on Christmas Eve and are swept by the Wish Collector into the musical Land of Sometimes, where they learn that wishes have consequences.

upcoming.title: EBENEZER: A CHRISTMAS CAROL
upcoming.description: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The name you know, the story you don’t. EBENEZER follows a miserly businessman who is forced through visions of the past, present, and future during a supernatural journey toward a chance at redemption.

upcoming.title: How To Rob A Bank
upcoming.description: Nicholas Hoult and Pete Davidson are part of a group of bank robbers who share their heists on social media in this tongue-in-cheek thriller from the director of Bullet Train.

upcoming.title: Disney's Hexed
upcoming.description: In Walt Disney Animation Studios' all-new magical coming-of-age saga, “Hexed,” an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever.

upcoming.title: Focker In-Law
upcoming.description: The circle of trust just got bigger. This November, comedy icon and Emmy winner Ben Stiller and two-time Oscar winner Robert De Niro reunite, joined by Grammy winner and Oscar nominee Ariana Grande, in Focker-In-Law, a new chapter in the blockbuster Meet the Parents franchise.

upcoming.title: [FRE] Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
upcoming.description: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell).

upcoming.description: Garance is a young actress but not a star. She manages things as best she can, finding fuel and comfort in alcohol. As she embarks for an eight-year journey of life changes, she drinks more and more. Until death seems to loom.

upcoming.description: Dune: Part Three is based on the novel Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert and delivers the epic conclusion to Villeneuve’s trilogy.

upcoming.description: An epic new take on Victor Hugo's timeless classic.

upcoming.title: [FRE] Parallel Tales
